_meta.indication: AJOVY is indicated for the preventive treatment of migraine in adults.

pivotal_trials.population: Adults with a history of episodic migraine (<15 headache days per month)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Mean change from baseline in the monthly average number of migraine days during the 3-month treatment period
pivotal_trials.n: 875 patients randomized (225 mg monthly N=287, 675 mg quarterly N=288, placebo N=290)
pivotal_trials.result: Change from baseline in monthly migraine days -3.7 (225 mg monthly) and -3.4 (675 mg quarterly) vs -2.2 placebo; difference from placebo -1.5 and -1.2 (p<0.001 both); >=50% responders 47.7% and 44.4% vs 27.9% placebo

pivotal_trials.population: Adults with a history of chronic migraine (>=15 headache days per month)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Mean change from baseline in the monthly average number of headache days of at least moderate severity during the 3-month treatment period
pivotal_trials.n: 1130 patients randomized (225 mg monthly N=375, 675 mg quarterly N=375, placebo N=371)
pivotal_trials.result: Change from baseline in monthly headache days of at least moderate severity -4.6 (225 mg monthly) and -4.3 (675 mg quarterly) vs -2.5 placebo; difference from placebo -2.1 and -1.8 (p<0.001 both); >=50% responders 40.8% and 37.6% vs 18.1% placebo

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (>=5% and greater than placebo) were injection site reactions; injection site reactions occurred in 43% (225 mg monthly) and 45% (675 mg quarterly) vs 38% placebo; reactions most commonly led to discontinuation (1%).
target_moa: Fremanezumab-vfrm is a humanized monoclonal antibody that binds to CGRP ligand and blocks its binding to the CGRP receptor (blocks both alpha- and beta-CGRP isoforms).

rems.type: A REMS is not necessary for this product.

advisory_committee.vote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because it was clear that the applicant had provided substantial evidence of effectiveness from two adequate and well-controlled studies.
